name: A Meeting with the Master
objectiveText: Bring 2 Undamaged Hippogryph Feathers to Sanath Lim-yo in Azshara if you wish to speak to his master. Undamaged Hippogryph Feather  ( 2 )

comments.body: It is no longer neccessary to collect feathers in exchange for transportation. Simply talk to the servent (Found east of the Horde camp) and he will send you up into the mountains. From there travel along the path and you will be able to complete the delivery.
When you click on him now, he complains about how once upon a time he was allowed to demand whatever he wanted of visitors, now he's required to just teleport them at once.  :-)
[Classic] This quest is obsolete in Classic as the NPCs will teleport you when talked to with no reagents. All feathers can be vendored as they have no other use.
replies: Also, if anyone is wondering, there's no point in going up to Xylem's tower without the "Delivery to Archmage Xylem" quest. The NPCs in the tower don't start any quests, unless you're a level 60 mage.

comments.body: Sanath Lim-yo is located: 28,50

Upon completion (which took 26 kills to get the 2 feathers for), he teleports you up to the nearby highlands.  There's a tower with some NPCs inside and one outside, but none of them talk to me.  What was the point of this?

Tower campers:
Archmage Xylem (VERY cool 'water wings' on him)
Joy Ar'nareth
Rayan Dawnrisen

Outside:
Coral Moongale

Also:
Nyrill <Xylem's Apprentice>, who has the "instaquest" to get back down. (no requirements).
replies: I assume that at some point there will be more quests in Aszhara, so by then he may have a role to play for Alliance too. The access quest was quite good, but then.. nothing more.

comments.body:
[mostly stated above, just thought some folks might want a little more detail]

As of July, 18 2005; v1.6- Alliance:
You can Find the Thunderhead Hyppogryphs just south of 20,52. The drop rate on feathers, for me, was 1 for 1.

After completing "A Meeting with the Master" you are teleported not to the tower; but to a hilltop summoning circle North-West of Sanath Lim-yo (28,50).

The summoning circle and Nyrill are located at 26,46. Nyrill will teleport you back to Sanath Lim-yo, upon your request.

If you follow a path NW, up a mountain, to the tower (29,40). There are still no alliance quests. Again, with a 50th level Night Elf, Coral Moonglade, located outside the tower-east.
===
Make sure you run into the undead litches, then drop plenty of silver and mageweave; you can find them around 15,70
===
Cordinates are CosmosUI
You no longer need to do this quest - They will just teleport you for the asking.

After you give him the 2 feathers he will teleport you to (26,46) which is up in the mountains. After you have been portaled and take the path up further you will come to a Tower. At the top of the tower is Archmage Xylem, Joy Ar'nareth, and Rayan Dawnrisen.

After completing the quest 'Stealing Knowledge' by Jediga (22,52), she will send you on 4 delivery quests. One of them is for Xylem on top of the tower.

Might be for the Horde only.

to make use out of this quest, you need to have completed the quest, "stealing knowledge."

when you complete that quest, you deliver one of the tablets to archmage sylem.

hope this helps.

The map grid system is part of the Cosmos UI (and possibly others).  You can approximate the position if you don't have the program.  0,0 is upper left corner, 0,100 lower left, 100,0 upper right, 100,100 lower right... therefore 50,50 is the center of the map.  28,50 would be about 1/4 across the map, halfway down.
replies:
I ask for that information many times before I upgraded to a PC with enough resources to run mods along with the game. Your post is the first that I have seen to answer the question. CT_MapMod is another program that uses the coordinates. 

A few days ago I read a post with a script that prints your current coordinated in the chat box. I saved the script, but I forgot to save the author's name.  

[quote]Type /macro, select New and use this script: 

/script px,py=GetPlayerMapPosition("player") 
/script DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(format("[ %s ] %i , %i",GetZoneText(),px*100,py*100)); 

May
